recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12337 unless a future Pharmacy decision changes the semantics of MedicationRequest.category or MedicationStatement.category search.
issue_request: FHIR-12337 was a Published Pharmacy change request with resolution Persuasive. It asked to add category search parameters for MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement after the related category elements were added for medication resources.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied on November 14, 2016 in build@10195. Git commit a14bb96e0367318a523b0e66a833135d974822b5 corroborates this by explicitly saying TR#12337 added category to search parameters for medicationstatement and medicationrequest and by adding token search rows for MedicationRequest.category and MedicationStatement.category.
additional_context: The historical MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder artifact is represented by the current MedicationRequest resource. MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement are active resources in source/fhir.ini, the 2021 source refactor retained the category search parameters in the current bundle-MedicationRequest-search-params.xml and bundle-MedicationStatement-search-params.xml inputs, and release-history artifacts show the parameters persisted through later published releases. FHIR-10141 is the prerequisite category-element issue, and FHIR-12345 was applied in the same historical commit but is a separate binding-description typo already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active search-parameter bundle inputs already define category token SearchParameters with expressions MedicationRequest.category and MedicationStatement.category.
